releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.3 (Build 14)
• WhatsApp-style chat list selection toolbar: Pin to top, Mute with custom duration, Archive, and Delete locally
• Mute notifications suppression for muted conversations
• Right-swipe gesture on message bubbles to reply with animated arrow and haptic trigger
• Two-tier message deletion: 'Delete for me' (local SQLite) and 'Delete for everyone' (remote tombstone)
• Full-screen interactive photo viewer with pinch-to-zoom, pan, save to Pictures, and share
• Real document & PDF sharing, download manager, and FileProvider external app opening
• Complete cleanup and removal of legacy location coordinates
• Non-destructive SQLite schema v10 database migration
